we develop an online control scheme that can provide a feasible, efficient, and robust solution, with the help of a Lyapunov technique, for EH networks with battery imperfection, without requiring any prior knowledge of stochastic processes.
we propose a stochastic online control algorithm for multi-hop EH networks with practical battery model, and prove that the algorithm can provide a data rate utility maximizing solution.

the development of a practical and efficient control scheme for EH wireless networks with battery limitations.
the design of a practical online control algorithm to optimize the utility of EH wireless network under battery imperfections.
the design of a practical and efficient online control scheme for EH networks, which can be applied to a wide class of stochastic EH systems with various battery imperfections.
